instructions: AGP is a Slack-native governance plane (Bun + TypeScript) that gates every tool call and writes a signed, hash-chained audit journal. Prioritize fail-closed correctness, no regression to the signed-journal invariants, and the repo's claim-control discipline. The required CI gates (typecheck, Biome lint, coverage floor, claim-scan, doc-drift, audit-harness verify/escape-scan, dependency-cruiser arch) are the deterministic gate — don't re-litigate nits those already catch; focus on logic, security, and invariant regressions.

rules.rule: Public surfaces (README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, SUPPORT.md, .github/**) may make exactly ONE security claim: 'signed audit log of every tool call'. Do NOT propose adding any stronger assurance wording (the claim-scan denylist); flag any change that introduces one.
This is a Bun + TypeScript repo, not Node/npm. Do NOT suggest npm/pnpm/yarn commands or Node-only APIs; use bun install / bun test / bun run.
Leaf layers must not import the daemon: src/contracts/, src/policy/, and src/journal/ must NOT import from src/daemon/ (enforced by dependency-cruiser). Flag any such import.

Governance boundaries are fail-closed: gate, journal-append, and secret/credential checks must reject on ambiguity, never default-allow. The frozen Actor enum and the JournalEvent schema must not change shape without an ADR.
